findings.finding_summary: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma, 85mm in diameter, WHO/ISUP nuclear grade 2, without sarcomatoid or rhabdoid differentiation. Invasion of the renal vein/segmental branches and of the renal sinus/peripelvic fat is present; no microvascular invasion, pelvicalyceal system invasion, or perinephric fat invasion. Surgical margins clear. Staged pT3a.

specimens.general_features_summary: Background kidney showed no significant abnormality. Renal pelvis and ureter showed no evidence of urothelial neoplasia. Adrenal not involved.

report_summary: Left radical nephrectomy shows clear cell renal cell carcinoma, 85mm diameter, WHO/ISUP nuclear grade 2, invading the renal vein and renal sinus/peripelvic fat, staged pT3a, with clear surgical margins. Leibovich score places this in the intermediate risk group (5). No sarcomatoid/rhabdoid differentiation, microvascular invasion, pelvicalyceal invasion, or perinephric fat invasion. Background kidney, renal pelvis/ureter, and adrenal gland unremarkable.
